Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.

actual_scope: Permit arbitrary deterministic pointwise finite-alphabet gates in the all-role rational-frame contract and prove a cut inequality. Derive the common-flag rank obstruction without the predecessor's XOR assumption.
scope_change_reason: This studies nonlinear scalar-gate freedom rather than a finite nonabelian address group. The cut proof supplies a uniform negative result for the common-flag geometry; it does not claim a new supplier.
bottleneck_link: Nonlinear gates alone cannot create recursive contraction inside common-flag or commuting frame families. A viable nonlinear mechanism must also change the frame geometry and pass topology and full dirty-input checks.
stop_rule: Complete the universal cut proof, nonlinear semantic controls, exact finite evidence, source binding and overlap refresh. Do not infer an unrestricted nonlinear impossibility result or publish the duplicated joint-helper theorem.
